e.title: GINSIM
e.summary: GINA 基因信息非歧视政策的保险经济评估（JAX 蒙特卡洛+博弈论）：政策模拟沙盒
e.body: GINSIM（Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation）是基因信息非歧视政策（GINA）的保险经济评估模型：JAX/XLA 高性能蒙特卡洛模拟 + 梯度优化，基准政策场景（status_quo/moratorium/ban）对比，分布性成本效益分析（DCBA，跨风险五分位与土著人群），博弈论框架（投保人与保险公司的纳什均衡、对抗性重优化），Streamlit 交互沙盒。对 RIAA：保险×基因信息×政策的计算建模前沿（精算与政策交叉）。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]（风险分类）、[[insurance-governance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。

e.summary_en: Insurance-economic evaluation of the GINA genetic-information non-discrimination policy (JAX Monte Carlo + game theory): policy simulation sandbox
e.summary_hk: GINA 基因信息非歧視政策的保險經濟評估（JAX 蒙特卡羅+博弈論）：政策模擬沙盒
e.body_en: GINSIM (Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation) is an insurance-economic model of genetic-information non-discrimination policy (GINA): JAX/XLA high-performance Monte Carlo simulation + gradient-based optimisation, policy-benchmark comparisons (status_quo/moratorium/ban), distributional cost-benefit analysis (DCBA across risk quintiles and Indigenous populations), a game-theoretic framework (Nash equilibria between insurers and applicants, adversarial re-optimisation) and a Streamlit interactive sandbox. For RIAA: the computational-modelling frontier of insurance × genetic information × policy. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]] (risk classification), [[insurance-governance]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].
e.body_hk: GINSIM（Genetic Information Non-Discrimination Policy Integrated Economic Evaluation）是基因信息非歧視政策（GINA）的保險經濟評估模型：JAX/XLA 高性能蒙特卡羅模擬 + 梯度優化，基準政策場景（status_quo/moratorium/ban）對比，分佈性成本效益分析（DCBA，跨風險五分位與土著人群），博弈論框架（投保人與保險公司的納什均衡、對抗性重優化），Streamlit 交互沙盒。對 RIAA：保險×基因信息×政策的計算建模前沿（精算與政策交叉）。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]（風險分類）、[[insurance-governance]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。
